svg.title: What the boundary tape actually stores
svg.desc: Two- and three-dimensional domains show a PML velocity shell and narrow direction-specific traction strips. Velocity-shell intersections are stored once, while traction blocks may overlap.

g.aria-label: What the boundary tape actually stores
Velocity shell: all d velocity components
Traction strips: only stresses needed by each face
3D: z-face (σzz, σyz, σxz); y-face (σyz, σyy, σxy)
Strip depth ≤ stencil radius. High-side half-grid plane is included.
StarWave · Implementation schematic, not simulation data
